name: Servicios de calidad económica
formula: COUNT(trip eligible AND delivery_complete=true AND on_time=true AND severe_attributable_incident=false AND pod_accepted=true AND cost_complete=true) / COUNT(completed eligible trip)

name: Contribution margin percent
guardrail: No usar sin monto y cobertura

name: Win rate
formula: COUNT(accepted_quote_version) / COUNT(quote_version with terminal accepted or rejected)

name: Quote turnaround p50
guardrail: Mostrar p90 y calidad de datos

name: OTIF
formula: COUNT(eligible delivery complete_in_full=true AND completed_at<=window_end) / COUNT(eligible completed delivery)

name: On-time pickup
formula: COUNT(eligible pickup with arrival_at<=window_end) / COUNT(eligible pickup)

name: On-time delivery
formula: COUNT(eligible delivery with completion_at<=window_end) / COUNT(eligible delivery)

name: Dwell time p50
guardrail: Excluir tiempo atribuible documentado por política

name: Exception rate
formula: COUNT(started trip with at least one material exception) / COUNT(started trip)

name: First-attempt delivery
formula: COUNT(eligible delivery completed on attempt_number=1) / COUNT(eligible delivery)

name: ETA mean absolute error
formula: AVG(ABS(actual_arrival_at - predicted_arrival_at)) for prediction frozen at declared horizon

name: PM compliance
formula: COUNT(task completed before due_threshold) / COUNT(task reaching due_threshold in period)

name: Unbilled completed value
formula: SUM(validated_charge_amount where delivery_complete=true AND invoice_id IS NULL)

name: Cost completeness
formula: COUNT(required_cost_category with valid cost or approved zero) / COUNT(required_cost_category)

name: Three-way match first pass
formula: COUNT(invoice matched without exception on first validation) / COUNT(eligible invoice with PO and receipt)

name: On-time payment
formula: COUNT(payment executed within policy window) / COUNT(eligible payable due)
guardrail: No premiar pago temprano que dañe liquidez

name: Trip profitability coverage
formula: COUNT(completed trip with profitability status provisional or final) / COUNT(completed eligible trip)

name: POD first-pass yield
formula: COUNT(evidence accepted without prior rejection) / COUNT(first evidence submission)

name: Claim rate
formula: COUNT(eligible delivery with claim) / COUNT(eligible delivery)

name: Case resolution SLA
formula: COUNT(eligible closed case with resolved_at<=sla_due_at) / COUNT(eligible closed case)

name: Recurrence rate
formula: COUNT(case linked to same validated root_cause within policy_window) / COUNT(case with validated root_cause)

name: Training compliance
formula: COUNT(person with all required training valid) / COUNT(eligible person)

name: PO compliance
formula: SUM(spend with approved PO before commitment) / SUM(eligible_spend)

name: Supplier OTIF
formula: COUNT(eligible PO line received complete by promised_date) / COUNT(eligible PO line)

name: Stockout rate
formula: COUNT(request not fulfilled due to insufficient stock) / COUNT(eligible inventory request)

name: Inventory accuracy
formula: COUNT(count line within tolerance) / COUNT(count line)

name: Critical field completeness
formula: COUNT(required critical field with valid value) / COUNT(expected critical field)

name: Duplicate master rate
formula: COUNT(confirmed duplicate active master) / COUNT(active master)

name: Reconciliation coverage
formula: COUNT(eligible chain fully reconciled) / COUNT(eligible chain)

name: Manual override rate
formula: COUNT(automated decision overridden) / COUNT(automated decision reviewed)

name: Decision evaluation rate
formula: COUNT(material decision with outcome evaluated) / COUNT(material decision whose evaluation_window ended)

name: Metric certification coverage
formula: COUNT(displayed metric with certified active definition) / COUNT(displayed official metric)

name: Tenant activation
formula: COUNT(tenant completing configured_activation_milestone) / COUNT(tenant onboarding started)

name: Core workflow adoption
formula: COUNT(eligible user completing core_action) / COUNT(eligible active user)

name: Platform availability
guardrail: Excluir solo mantenimiento anunciado por política

name: Error-free task completion
formula: COUNT(core task completed without system_error or rework) / COUNT(core task attempt)
